title: Open Road Risk: an open-data pipeline for exposure-adjusted collision risk on the GB road network
description: Open Road Risk is a staged open-data pipeline for estimating exposure-adjusted collision risk on the GB road network. It combines DfT STATS19 collision records, DfT AADF traffic counts, OS Open Roads geometry, National Highways WebTRIS sensor data, OpenStreetMap attributes, and ONS deprivation indices to produce link-level risk scores for OS Open Roads links across Northern and Central England (2015-2024).
